title: Add Teams to a List
instructions:
Complete the function `addTeams()`. It should:

1. Create an empty mutable list of `Int`
2. Add the team numbers 4215, 1234, and 5678 to the list
3. Print the size of the list
hint: Use `mutableListOf<Int>()` to create an empty list, then call `.add()` three times. Print with `println(list.size)`.
solutionCode:
fun addTeams() {
    val teams = mutableListOf<Int>()
    teams.add(4215)
    teams.add(1234)
    teams.add(5678)
    println(teams.size)
}
